items.title: Introducing Runway Ruby
items.excerpt: Runway Ruby is a new model that generates 16-bit HDR ProRes and EXR sequences, or converts existing clips into them — pushing generative video into finishing-grade formats that film pipelines actually ingest.

items.title: Nikola Todorovic on the latest developments in Autodesk's Flow Studio
items.excerpt: Flow Studio (ex-Wonder Dynamics) adds a 3D Editor + Canvas: a single workspace for generation, scene assembly, rendering and refinement, aimed at giving filmmakers shot-level control over AI output.

items.title: Eddie AI Launches an Agent Marketplace of Editing Agents Built on Great Filmmakers
items.excerpt: Eddie AI's new Agent Marketplace offers assistant-editing agents built on the stated rules of well-known editors and directors, letting cutters swap in a named editorial point of view.

items.title: Caira gets AI generative video editing feature
items.excerpt: Camera Intelligence's Caira adds generative video editing driven by Gemini and Runway Aleph, moving prompt-based shot manipulation onto the camera itself rather than into post.

items.title: Avid Media Composer 2026.8 is now available
items.excerpt: Media Composer 2026.8 ships ahead of IBC with PhraseFindAI multicam auto-cut on speech boundaries, Ready to Edit prep automation and a Google Gemini panel inside the editor.

items.title: AccuFACE 2 Grand Launch: Professional-Grade Facial Mocap for CC5 HD Characters
items.excerpt: Reallusion's AccuFACE 2 pushes markerless AI facial capture toward production quality, driving CC5 HD characters from ordinary webcam or camera footage without a head rig.

items.title: Introducing Solaris, our first Interface World Model
items.excerpt: Solaris is described as a new kind of operating system that generates interactive interfaces frame by frame — Runway's first world model aimed at generated, navigable screens rather than clips.

items.title: Crafty Apes CEO Alana Newell
items.excerpt: From compositor to CEO: Alana Newell on where Crafty Apes is taking its VFX pipeline, and how AI-assisted tooling is reshaping the shop's craft and staffing.

items.title: EditShare Updates at IBC Include EFS, Flow AI and MediaSilo
items.excerpt: EditShare will show all-in-one EFS configurations with GPU-powered Flow AI processing built into the storage nodes, plus expanded multilingual transcription across MediaSilo.

items.title: AI Sci-Fi Series 'Kira' Heads To MIPCOM For Ex Machina & K5, First Look Images
items.excerpt: An AI-generated sci-fi series goes to market with first-look images, testing whether a fully generative look can carry a scripted drama into international distribution.

items.title: Danny Boyle speaks out against AI proliferation: "It's insane what we're doing"
items.excerpt: At Venice for 'Ink', Danny Boyle argues the industry's rush into generative tools is corroding the verification work that journalism — and filmmaking — depends on.

items.title: 'The View' Host Sunny Hostin Licenses Her Likeness to AI Studio: 'A New Art Form'
items.excerpt: Sunny Hostin has licensed her digital likeness to an AI studio, an early test case for how on-camera talent negotiates consented synthetic performance.

items.title: Nicola Coughlan, Matt Lucas, Hugh Bonneville and More Back Campaign Against AI Voice Cloning
items.excerpt: Performers back a legal campaign against unlicensed AI voice cloning, calling synthetic voice replication "an existential threat" to voice and dubbing work.

items.title: Google DeepMind, Amazon Web Services, Kling AI Join Busan Market Tech Program InnoAsia
items.excerpt: Busan's ACFM puts Google DeepMind, AWS and Kling AI on its InnoAsia tech track, pitching generative video tooling directly at Asian producers and filmmakers.
